name: Brut Paris Attraction Totale All-In-One Hair & Body Shower Gel 500ml
description:
Description:
Experience full-body freshness with the Brut Paris Attraction Totale All-In-One Hair & Body Shower Gel, specially designed for men. Its aromatic formula gently cleanses both hair and skin, removing dirt and grime while leaving you refreshed and energized.

Key Features:

All-In-One Formula: Suitable for both hair and body.

Gentle Cleansing: Mild formula cleanses without drying your skin.

Invigorating Aroma: Fougère top notes of lemon, lime, and mandarin, complemented by galbanum and blackcurrant for a fruity, masculine scent.

Eliminates Body Odour: Uplifting fragrance keeps you feeling fresh all day.

Made in Spain
